programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2007/08 season. Cristiano Ronaldo topped the scoring charts with a remarkable 31 goals, ahead of Fernando Torres and Emmanuel Adebayor on 24.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2008/09 season. Chelsea striker Nicolas Anelka secured the Golden Boot with 19 goals, beating Cristiano Ronaldo to the prize.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.desc: We revisit the best goals from the 2009/2010 season. In his most prolific season for Chelsea, Didier Drogba secured the Golden Boot with 29 goals, three ahead of Wayne Rooney.

programme.title: Classic Premier League

programme.title: Classic Premier League

programme.title: Classic Premier League

programme.title: Classic Premier League

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.desc: A review of the 2014/15 season. Eden Hazard's superb form helped Chelsea clinch their fifth title and newly-promoted Burnley and QPR made immediate returns to the Championship.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.desc: A review of the 2015/16 season. Leicester City shocked the footballing world, Jose Mourinho's second tenure at Chelsea came to an end and Newcastle dropped into the second tier.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2016/17 season. Harry Kane won the Golden Boot for the second successive season with 29 goals, scoring seven goals in Spurs' last two games.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
